institutions.title: Dinastías y cronologías babilónicas
institutions.text: Primera dinastía, poderes casitas y dinastías posteriores son fases distintas. Se emplea la cronología media para Hammurabi y una tabla convencional posterior, conservando las discrepancias de los campos archivados. La falta de un titular casita temprano bien fechado queda registrada; no se cubre con fechas vitales ni con una línea ficticia.

governance.sourceLabel: Instituciones de la Edad del Bronce
governance.note: Clasificación de poderes documentados; no ideología moderna, monarquía absoluta por defecto ni prueba de una constitución uniforme en todo el contorno.

reignFields.raw: {{circa}} 1064–1043 BC{{efn|Previous scholarship assumed that Marduk-kabit-ahheshu, the founder of the second dynasty of Isin, ruled for the first years of his reign concurrently with the last Kassite king, but per Beaulieu (2018), more recent research suggests that this was not the case, necessitating a revised chronology of the kings after Marduk-kabit-ahheshu. Adad-apla-iddina has previously been dated to about 1067–1046 BC, with 1064–1043 BC being Beaulieu's revised dates.<ref>{{Cite book|last=Beaulieu|first=Paul-Alain|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=yMhQDwAAQBAJ&q=%22Dynasty+of+E%22&pg=PA12|title=A History of Babylon, 2200 BC - AD 75|publisher=Wiley|year=2018|isbn=978-1405188999|location=Pondicherry|pages=154–155}}</ref>}}

Enlil-nadin-apli has previously been dated to about 1103–1100 BC, with 1099–1096 BC being Beaulieu's revised dates.<ref>{{Cite book|last=Beaulieu|first=Paul-Alain|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=yMhQDwAAQBAJ&q=%22Dynasty+of+E%22&pg=PA12|title=A History of Babylon, 2200 BC - AD 75|publisher=Wiley|year=2018|isbn=978-1405188999|location=Pondicherry|pages=154–155}}</ref>}}
